study: Canonical Dual Momentum Stock-Characteristics Audit v1
question: Among stocks actually selected by unchanged canonical Dual Momentum, do point-in-time price or liquidity characteristics identify stronger next-rebalance SPY-relative outcomes?

population.strategy: registered canonical Dual Momentum, 189-session lookback, monthly rebalance, top N = 5
population.includedRows: selected_by_canonical == true with complete exact-open next-rebalance outcomes
population.informationBoundary: features use the final daily bar strictly before the rebalance session; outcomes use the rebalance open through the next rebalance open
population.scope: conditional description inside the selected top-five portfolio, not a test of the full eligible universe

primaryFeatures.label: 63-session annualized volatility
primaryFeatures.definition: sample standard deviation of the last 63 close-to-close returns multiplied by sqrt(252)

primaryFeatures.label: 126-session SPY beta
primaryFeatures.definition: covariance of stock and SPY close-to-close returns divided by SPY return variance over the latest 126 aligned sessions

primaryFeatures.label: 20-session log average dollar volume
primaryFeatures.definition: natural log of mean adjusted close times volume over the latest 20 sessions

primaryFeatures.label: Distance from 252-session high
primaryFeatures.definition: latest adjusted close divided by the maximum adjusted close over the latest 252 sessions, minus one; larger values are nearer the high

primaryOutcome: stock exact-open next-rebalance return minus aligned SPY exact-open return
estimand: percentage-point change in next-period active return for a one-standard-deviation within-rebalance increase in the characteristic, after rebalance-date demeaning

inference.null: within each rebalance, apply the same random permutation of outcomes to all five fixed feature columns; use the maximum absolute cluster t statistic
inference.missingPolicy: drop a row only from the affected feature; never impute

descriptiveOnly: top-two versus bottom-two characteristic buckets within each rebalance
raw stock return and win-rate summaries

qualificationRule.requirements: 95% cluster-bootstrap CI excludes zero, familywise p <= 0.10, coverage >= 95%, first and second half have the same sign, and at least 80% of usable leave-one-year-out estimates share the full-sample direction
qualificationRule.interpretation: A qualifying result justifies one separately preregistered validation study; it does not authorize a filter, weight, order, or sizing change.

excludedForDataIntegrity.sector: No genuine point-in-time historical sector-classification ledger is installed.
excludedForDataIntegrity.marketCap: No point-in-time shares-outstanding/security-master history is installed.
excludedForDataIntegrity.fundamentals: Historical point-in-time accounting snapshots with filing availability dates are not installed.
excludedForDataIntegrity.currentCompanyLabels: Present-day classifications may not be applied backward.

prohibited: searching additional features or thresholds after seeing results
constructing a filtered or reweighted portfolio
treating five simultaneous holdings as five independent observations
modifying any frozen forward test or Alpaca execution setting
